_comment: Tooltip glossary. Mirrors V&T V4 Correct Terms Glossary + core brand terms. Auto-linked first occurrence per page; term -> tooltip text. "link" is the tooltip's See-page target — every term lands on its anchor on the Glossary page (anchor = kebab-cased term; keep in sync with GlossaryList.astro's slugify). "page" is the governing page, shown as 'Governed by' on /glossary/. Optional "matchCase": true makes a term match case-sensitively — used for proper nouns.

terms.tip: Core tagline — the voice of the Brand Promise. Full line: 'Create with love. Share with joy. Connect from smile to smile.' Never paraphrased.
Balizen is a verified MEMBER of the Fair Trade Federation, for over twenty years. Say 'member' — never 'certified' about products.
Correct phrasing for product-level fair trade claims: 'made in our fair trade workshop' — individual products are not independently certified.
Balizen's printing technique. Never plain 'printed', never 'batik' (a wax-resist technique we don't use).
Say 'eco-friendly seaweed-based dyes' — specific and true. Not 'natural dyes' (vague) or 'chemical-free' (potentially inaccurate).
Vetiver root — never 'straw' or 'grass'. Naturally fragrant; the same roots prevent soil erosion in Bali.
Capiz shell — not 'mother of pearl' (different material). The Gardenia Bali chimes material.
'Reclaimed wood', not 'recycled wood' — different process.
'Remnant' or 'leftover' fabric — never 'scrap' (sounds like waste). Basis of the patchwork / zero-waste lines.
Balizen's cutter — he oversees cutting (not sewing). Twenty years translating Andrea's ideas into finished pieces.
Always 'workshop' — never 'factory' or 'facility'.
Balizen = Doing something positive for people & the planet. The single idea we want to own; 'From smile to smile' is how it sounds.
Values · The Tourist Journey · Education. Every audience sees Balizen through all three — dial up or down, never drop one.
One of the Three Lenses: from holiday to home. Tourism and hosting are at the heart of Balizen — wherever a customer discovers us, they're taking a piece of Bali home.
Primary audience: women 30–55, home-and-family oriented, shopping homewares, gifts and slow fashion with intention. Many first meet Balizen as travelers.
Secondary audience: younger shoppers 25–35, Instagram-native, capsule-wardrobe minded. They buy fewer, better things — and share what they love.
Every reel closes on a brand frame: wordmark, FTF VERIFIED mark, or 'From smile to smile.' — set on Balizen Teal, Spice, Tree Hugger, or black.
The Tourist Journey lens: customers discover Balizen traveling, and the relationship continues long after the trip.
Balizen trains people just starting out — handicraft, computer work, on-the-job learning. 'Giving people an opportunity to improve themselves.'
Voice Pillar 5 & brand attribute: refined without fussy, beautifully made and honestly priced. Elegant doesn't mean humorless. 'Luxury' and 'premium' stay banned.
